3.content: ... ... The Great Spirit too, which is in it, is like a wise [crafts

spiritual_reading:
The good that first engages evil is as a mighty and discerning state of the Divine in ultimates that has been deprived of its own precious goods and truths; and it goes forth by purposeful influx to recover what has been alienated. So it bends itself from the higher degree into the lower, pursuing the separated operative powers, in order to liberate them, restore them into order, and gather back the Divine possessions that had been dispersed and held fast within contrary loves and falsities.

It is also as a state of love that has had its paired principles torn away from it by adverse forces; and it extends itself toward them to redeem them. Thus the first good remains in luminous eminence, not from itself alone but because its paired principles have been sundered and must be reunited. These are its living animation: the reciprocal life of love and wisdom existing in a dual form of operation, which therefore becomes complete in the outermost degree.

Again, the ordered progression of enlightened discernment in the external degree is as a piercing power of truth that goes forth with authority. Within that progression is the Divine operative Spirit as an intelligence that brings every defending truth into beauty, sets them in right arrangement, and equips the whole mind for spiritual combat against evils and falsities.

Again, the Divine operative Spirit is as the zeal of truth from good that advances toward a derivative of the ruling good which has been captured in conflict, and it delivers that subordinate good from the dominion of opposites that had bound it.

So also the mediating influx that speaks for the Divine is as a great power of communication and conjunction, acting because of the Divine goods and truths that have been seized and bound. It stirs and orders the liberated powers of light and all that proceeds from them, together with the life that is theirs, so that what had been shut up in a lower state may be brought forth into freedom, restored to its proper place, and made serviceable again in the realm where use can be effected.

fills.notes: The second similitude requires an agent in the opposite camp who seizes the two sons; in this substrate register the simplest, non-institutional term is “enemies,” matching ¶1 and keeping the impersonal cosmological tone. The immediate return “He came out toward them” then resumes the redeemer’s action.

The sentence needs only the correspondential hinge: the First Man “also shines” in the heights because of the separated paired principles. Adding names or titles here would shift toward later framing; the oldest layer keeps it structural.

fills.fill: of truth that is set in battle array. Thus
fills.notes: The ship of day corresponds to ordered progression of enlightened discernment in ultimates; its likeness to a spear demands the determinative quality: piercing truth in combat. The transition “Thus” cleanly carries into the next comparison about the Great Spirit within it arranging the armour.

The Ambassador in the oldest layer is the mediating, representative influx, not an ecclesial office. “Speaks for the heights” preserves the impersonal cosmological function and matches the spiritual sense of communication and conjunction from above.

The action is ‘because of the treasure’ that has been taken and held fast in the lower contrary domain; “bound and seized” states the condition that necessitates mediation and release, without importing later juridical or devotional phrasing.
The phrase “hand of his prisoners” requires the preposition to complete the idiom of extraction from captivity; this is the minimal restoration that preserves sense.

What is ordered is not only discrete ‘light powers’ but also what proceeds from them; “and all the sons and their soul” matches the spiritual sense (liberated powers together with their life) and keeps the old cosmological grouping.

The goal is emergence from imprisonment into the land where use can be effected. “Come out” is the required liberation-movement; “and that” links to “might be brought forth,” avoiding later salvation-language while keeping the causal-final structure.

assessment: Most lacunae are tightly constrained by the chain of correspondences: each similitude needs a specific functional predicate (pursuit of treasure, redemption of paired principles, spear as piercing truth, armour as ordered defending truths, ambassador as mediating speech). The larger gaps in ¶3 and ¶5 allow some variation in wording, but the oldest-layer register restricts additions to structural, impersonal cosmological functions rather than titles, exhortations, or institutional vocabulary.
